1.mascotDialogue: Balance factor, tesoro, is simply left-height minus right-height! Anything outside minus one to one triggers a rotation before we go further. The whole self-balancing trick, no more mysterious than that.

2.mascotDialogue: `rotateRight` lifts the left child up to become the new head of this family, and hands down her old right child to the demoted node — three pointer swaps, one operation. Beautiful, no?

3.mascotDialogue: After the rotation, 20 sits at the top with balance factor zero on both sides! Without it, 30 would have had a balance factor of two — a straight leaning line, not a tree at all.

4.mascotDialogue: The balance factor badge on node 30, this is the giveaway — two is a hard violation, shown plainly, no arithmetic in your head required.
